<Heading

  children={"Get the staffing gap for a path within a committed shift plan"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/staffing-gap"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Read-model projection: plannedHeads (from the committed ShiftPlan for buildingId+shiftId) vs. currently active LaborAssignment count for pathId. Raises PathUnderstaffed when active assignments fall short of plannedHeads. This surfaces the gap only — it never decides or performs a rebalance; that stays a human call recorded via POST /associates/\{id\}/assignments. ShiftPlan is keyed by building+shift, so both are required as query parameters alongside the path in the URL — a path's planned heads only make sense within one committed plan.
